description: This file contains a suite of unit tests for the GatewayEndpointStore component in a Swift project. The tests validate various aspects of gateway token resolution, URL constructions, configuration precedence, and host resolution logic, primarily for local and remote gateway modes.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStoreTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for GatewayEndpointStore, focusing on token resolution, configuration parsing, URL building, and host resolution logic.

methods.name: makeLaunchAgentSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of a launch agent with specified environment variables, token, and password.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Generates a fresh UserDefaults suite for testing with a unique name, clearing any previous data.

methods.name: resolve gateway token prefers env and falls back to launchd
methods.description: Test verifying that gateway token resolution prefers environment variable over launchd snapshot.

methods.name: resolve gateway token ignores launchd in remote mode
methods.description: Test ensuring that in remote mode, launchd snapshot is ignored for token resolution.

methods.name: resolveGatewayTokenUsesRemoteConfigToken
methods.description: Test to verify that remote configuration explicitly specifies the token.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPasswordFallsBackToLaunchd
methods.description: Test verifying fallback of password resolution to launchd snapshot.

methods.name: connection mode resolver prefers config mode over defaults
methods.description: Test that configuration mode specified in root overrides user defaults.

methods.name: connection mode resolver trims config mode
methods.description: Test that mode strings are trimmed and correctly parsed.

methods.name: connection mode resolver falls back to defaults when missing config
methods.description: Test fallback to default configuration when mode is not specified in root.

methods.name: connection mode resolver falls back to defaults on unknown config
methods.description: Test fallback on unrecognized mode strings.

methods.name: connection mode resolver prefers remote URL when mode missing
methods.description: Test that presence of remote URL influences resolution when mode is missing.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host uses loopback for auto even with tailnet
methods.description: Test host resolution logic defaults to localhost for 'auto' bind mode with tailnet IP.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host uses loopback for auto without tailnet
methods.description: Test host resolution to localhost when tailnet IP is not available.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host prefers tailnet for tailnet mode
methods.description: Test that tailnet IP is used when bind mode is 'tailnet' and IP is available.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host falls back to loopback for tailnet mode
methods.description: Test fallback to localhost when tailnet IP is missing in tailnet mode.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host uses custom bind host
methods.description: Test that a custom host override is honored in host resolution.

methods.name: local config uses local gateway auth and host resolution
methods.description: Test that local configuration correctly uses launch agent token/password and resolves host and URL.

methods.name: dashboard URL uses local base path in local mode
methods.description: Test URL construction for dashboard in local mode, ensuring path is appended properly.

methods.name: dashboard URL skips local base path in remote mode
methods.description: Test URL construction in remote mode, ensuring base path is ignored.

methods.name: dashboard URL prefers path from config URL
methods.description: Test that URL fragments in config override base path consideration.

methods.name: dashboard URL uses fragment token and omits password
methods.description: Verify URL construction when token and password are provided, fragment used for token.

methods.name: normalize gateway url adds default port for loopback ws
methods.description: Test that loopback WebSocket URLs are normalized to include default port 18789.

methods.name: normalize gateway url rejects non loopback ws
methods.description: Test to reject WebSocket URLs that are not loopback addresses.

methods.name: normalize gateway url rejects prefix bypass loopback host
methods.description: Test to reject URLs with hostnames that attempt to bypass loopback restrictions.
